release_notes: FOODEX 1.0.43: Republish the Dashboard update under a new immutable version so installed 1.0.42 systems receive the shared-host public-runtime repair from #670/#671. Ship canonical `backend/public/**` files and safe shared-host aliases for `/assets/**`, `/brand/**`, `/demo/**`, and `/preview/**` in the same Dashboard update package. Repair public static-file and directory permissions during update extraction so Leaflet, Driver live tracking, FOODEX branding, and Customer/Driver App Preview runtimes resolve from the production document root. Preserve production AppVersion minimum/force-update rows, Driver fresh-location enforcement state, and Assistant disabled/read-only defaults.
